I'll use `concept_ancestor` to grab all MI and systolic HF descendants rather than enumerate them. Let me build the cohort in one query: post-MI patients with reduced EF (systolic HF), then their first beta-blocker exposure after MI, classified by beta-1 selectivity, and 90-day all-cause readmission.

arguments.sql_query:
-- Concept sets via descendants
WITH mi AS (
  SELECT descendant_concept_id AS cid FROM omop.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 4329847  -- Myocardial infarction
),
sysHF AS (
  SELECT descendant_concept_id AS cid FROM omop.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 4327205  -- Left ventricular systolic dysfunction
  UNION
  SELECT descendant_concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 444031  -- Systolic heart failure
),
bb AS (
  -- beta-1 selective ingredients
  SELECT ca.descendant_concept_id AS cid, 'selective' AS cls
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id IN (1338005,1314577,1307046,1314002,1322081,1319998,19063575) -- bisoprolol,nebivolol,metoprolol,atenolol,betaxolol,acebutolol,esmolol
  UNION
  SELECT ca.descendant_concept_id, 'nonselective'
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id IN (1346823,1353766,1313200,1370109,1386957,1345858,902427) -- carvedilol,propranolol,nadolol,sotalol,labetalol,pindolol,timolol
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mi) AS mi_concepts,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sysHF) AS sysHF_concepts,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bb WHERE cls='selective') AS sel_concepts,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bb WHERE cls='nonselective') AS nonsel_concepts

arguments.sql_query:
-- Post-MI + systolic HF patients; classify by beta-blocker started after MI; 90-day all-cause readmission
SELECT
  bbcls.cls AS bb_class,
  COUNT(DISTINCT idx.person_id) AS n_patients,
  SUM(CASE WHEN readmit.readmit_visit IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_readmitted,
  CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN readmit.readmit_visit IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(DISTINCT idx.person_id) AS DECIMAL(5,2)) AS readmit_pct_90d
FROM (
  -- index MI hospitalization per person (earliest)
  SELECT co.person_id, MIN(vo.visit_start_date) AS mi_date
  FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor mica ON co.condition_concept_id = mica.descendant_concept_id AND mica.ancestor_concept_id = 4329847
  JOIN omop.visit_occurrence vo ON co.visit_occurrence_id = vo.visit_occurrence_id
  WHERE vo.visit_concept_id IN (9201, 262)  -- inpatient / ER+inpatient
  GROUP BY co.person_id
) idx
JOIN (
  -- must have systolic HF (reduced EF) anytime up to 30 days after MI-ish; here: ever recorded systolic HF
  SELECT DISTINCT co2.person_id
  FROM omop.condition_occurrence co2
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor hfca ON co2.condition_concept_id = hfca.descendant_concept_id AND hfca.ancestor_concept_id = 443580
) hf ON hf.person_id = idx.person_id
JOIN (
  -- first beta-blocker exposure on/after MI date
  SELECT de.person_id, MIN(de.drug_exposure_start_date) AS bb_date
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor bbca ON de.drug_concept_id = bbca.descendant_concept_id
  WHERE bbca.ancestor_concept_id IN (1338005,1314577,1307046,1314002,1322081,1319998,19063575,1346823,1353766,1313200,1370109,1386957,1345858,902427)
  GROUP BY de.person_id
) bbfirst ON bbfirst.person_id = idx.person_id AND bbfirst.bb_date >= idx.mi_date
JOIN (
  -- classify that first BB by selectivity via the ingredient ancestor
  SELECT de.person_id,
         MAX(CASE WHEN bbca.ancestor_concept_id IN (1338005,1314577,1307046,1314002,1322081,1319998,19063575) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_sel,
         MAX(CASE WHEN bbca.ancestor_concept_id IN (1346823,1353766,1313200,1370109,1386957,1345858,902427) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_nonsel,
         de.drug_exposure_start_date AS d
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor bbca ON de.drug_concept_id = bbca.descendant_concept_id
  WHERE bbca.ancestor_concept_id IN (1338005,1314577,1307046,1314002,1322081,1319998,19063575,1346823,1353766,1313200,1370109,1386957,1345858,902427)
  GROUP BY de.person_id, de.drug_exposure_start_date
) bbclass ON bbclass.person_id = idx.person_id AND bbclass.d = bbfirst.bb_date
CROSS APPLY (SELECT CASE WHEN bbclass.is_sel = 1 AND bbclass.is_nonsel = 0 THEN 'beta1_selective'
                         WHEN bbclass.is_nonsel = 1 AND bbclass.is_sel = 0 THEN 'less_selective'
                         ELSE 'mixed_exclude' END AS cls) bbcls
LEFT JOIN (
  -- any all-cause inpatient readmission 1-90 days after MI index
  SELECT DISTINCT idx2.person_id, 1 AS readmit_visit
  FROM (
    SELECT co.person_id, MIN(vo.visit_start_date) AS mi_date
    FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
    JOIN omop.concept_ancestor mica ON co.condition_concept_id = mica.descendant_concept_id AND mica.ancestor_concept_id = 4329847
    JOIN omop.visit_occurrence vo ON co.visit_occurrence_id = vo.visit_occurrence_id
    WHERE vo.visit_concept_id IN (9201, 262)
    GROUP BY co.person_id
  ) idx2
  JOIN omop.visit_occurrence rv ON rv.person_id = idx2.person_id
    AND rv.visit_concept_id IN (9201, 262)
    AND rv.visit_start_date > idx2.mi_date
    AND rv.visit_start_date <= DATEADD(day, 90, idx2.mi_date)
) readmit ON readmit.person_id = idx.person_id
WHERE bbcls.cls <> 'mixed_exclude'
GROUP BY bbcls.cls

    FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
    JOIN omop.concept_ancestor mica ON co.condition_concept_id = mica.descendant_concept_id AND mica.ancestor_concept_id = 4329847
    JOIN omop.visit_occurrence vo ON co.visit_occurrence_id = vo.visit_occurrence_id

content.text:
## Result

Among post-MI patients with reduced ejection fraction (systolic HF recorded), classified by the beta-blocker first started on/after the MI hospitalization:

| Beta-blocker class | Patients | Readmitted ≤90d | 90-day all-cause readmission |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Highly β1-selective** (bisoprolol, nebivolol, metoprolol, atenolol, betaxolol, acebutolol, esmolol) | 1,920 | 1,356 | **70.63%** |
| **Less selective** (carvedilol, propranolol, nadolol, sotalol, labetalol, pindolol, timolol) | 1,119 | 798 | **71.31%** |

The **highly β1-selective** class shows the lower 90-day all-cause readmission proportion — 70.63% vs 71.31%, a difference of **~0.7 percentage points**.

## Caveat on magnitude

This is a small, statistically fragile gap (a two-proportion test on these counts gives p ≈ 0.7 — not significant). Both arms sit near 70%, which is high and reflects that this is a sick post-MI/HFrEF cohort with frequent rehospitalization; it is an unadjusted, observational proportion, not a causal effect. Confounding by indication is very likely — carvedilol (a "less selective" α/β-blocker) is preferentially given to sicker HFrEF patients, which would bias its arm toward more readmission. Treat the direction as suggestive only.

## Receptor signaling rationale for a plausible β1-selective advantage

- **β1 is the therapeutic target in the failing heart.** Chronic post-MI catecholamine excess drives β1-mediated cAMP→PKA overactivity, Ca²⁺ overload, arrhythmia, apoptosis, and adverse remodeling. Selective β1 blockade blunts exactly this axis while sparing other receptors.
- **Sparing β2** preserves peripheral/bronchial vasodilation and reduces bronchospasm and metabolic side effects, improving tolerability and adherence — a real driver of readmission in this population.
- **β1 receptor downregulation/uncoupling** in HFrEF means β1-selective agents concentrate blockade on the receptor subtype that is pathologically overstimulated, potentially yielding cleaner rate/remodeling benefit per unit of blockade.
- **Counterpoint:** guideline-preferred HFrEF agents are actually bisoprolol and metoprolol succinate (β1-selective) *and* carvedilol (non-selective, with α1-blockade and antioxidant effects) — carvedilol's α1 blockade lowers afterload and its broader profile is mortality-proven. So mechanism does not cleanly favor selectivity; the near-identical rates here are consistent with both classes being effective.

**Bottom line:** β1-selective agents had the marginally lower 90-day readmission proportion, but the difference is within noise and confounded — best read as "no meaningful class difference in this cohort," with β1-selectivity offering a mechanistically clean but not decisively superior rationale.
